text: The N=64-to-N=128 force drop is 0.064-0.072 on data_seed 1 against about 0.10-0.14 on data_seed 0, while the model-seed spread at N=128 on data_seed 1 is only 0.008. Is the size of the drop mainly a property of the dataset? Would data_seeds 2-3 with seeds 20-21 show whether the drop spread across data_seeds is larger than the spread across model seeds?
